html:
Window insulation film keeps your home cooler in summer and warmer in winter so you can enjoy a more comfortable temperature in your home all year round. Below, discover all the benefits of our insulation film and why it is such a great investment for your home.

Tint a Home is Australia’s most trusted tinting network for car, home and office window tinting. We have been providing tinting services in Australia for over 42 years. All home window tinting is done by professionally trained installers and we offer a lifetime warranty on residential applications. Here are the benefits of our insulation film

Benefits of Insulation Film

We have two insulating films in our range:

  1. Solar window films
  2. EnerLogic window film

Our solar window films:

  • Block out up to 79% of solar heat
  • Reduces glare by up to 93%
  • Block out 99% of the harmful UV rays

The EnerLogic window film is a high-performance insulation coating that dramatically transforms your windows so they are more energy-efficient.

Window insulation film for winter helps to keep your home warmer. It also makes your heating more efficient, so you’ll notice a positive difference to your power bills. Equally, insulating window film for summer keeps your home cooler and makes your air conditioning more efficient.

For privacy, you have the option of a film in darker shades or reflective film that stops those on the outside from seeing in whilst still letting in natural light.

Our insulation film is also available in lighter shades if you want to enjoy the benefits of insulation film without altering the appearance of your home.

Our insulation film also helps to prevent premature fading of your flooring and furnishings.

Interest-free payment options are available for car and home window tinting through Afterpay and Zip Pay where you can split your purchase over 3, 6, 9, or 12 months with ZERO interest.

Get A Quote For Insulation Film Today

If you’re ready to get window insulation film for winter or insulating window film for summer call 13 TINT or use our Store Finder to locate your nearest window tinting store to arrange a quote.
